Greetings, Agents! 

 

This is CM Fragment of MARVEL Future Fight.

 

Avengers Forever! 
Avengers classic and new are gathering again in MARVEL Future Fight this June.
Check out the looks of these heroes, some based on the comics and some original!

 

New Uniforms and Artifacts have been added for 
Iron Man, Ghost Rider (Robbie Reyes), Black Widow, and Blade!
Blade is now available for Tier-3 Advancement!
The symbol of the Avengers, Iron Man, 
will be the first to receive the new Tier-4 upgrade system!
 
The Super Heroes who have gained new abilities and skills 
will be a great help in the battles with the new Giant Boss Raid Boss: Dormammu  
and the World Boss: Legend Bosses with improved rewards.  

 

Also, with the addition of Tier-4, 
the Tier-2 search for Potential balance has been adjusted 
so prepare to give new powers to your heroes.

 

▣ Four New Uniforms

 

New Uniforms will be added for the four Avengers. 
* New Uniform Skills are based on Skill Level 6 stats.
* The four new uniforms will be on a 40% off discount during the <New Update Celebration Event!>, and can be purchased in the Marvel Universe and Uniform Room after the event. 

 

 

 

 


▣ Blade Tier-3 Advancement & Ultimate Skill


Tier-3 Advancement & Ultimate Skill will be added for Blade, 
ready to take on the dangers of the night.

 

 

 

▣ Ghost Rider (Robbie Reyes), Wasp (Nadia Van Dyne), 
and Nova (Sam Alexander) Potential Awakening & Transcendence 

 

Potential Awakening & Transcendence will be added for Ghost Rider (Robbie Reyes), 
Wasp (Nadia Van Dyne), and Nova (Sam Alexander) through the June Update.

 

 

 

 

 

 

▣ Iron Man Tier-4 Advancement & Striker Skill

 

Tier-4 Advancement & Striker Skill will be added 
to the most powerful heroes, with Iron Man as the first member.
* The Striker Skill stats are based on skill level 1.

 

 

 

▣ Tier-4 Advancement System

 

The new Tier-4 upgrade system has been added for heroes 
that are available for Potential Transcendence or Tier-3 Advancement. 
Achieve higher stats and new skills for your heroes!

 

1. Tier-4 Advancement can proceed when the following requirements are met.
▶ Reach Tier-3 or Potential Transcendence
▶ Reach Potential Lv. 12
▶ Reach Lv. 80
▶ Enhance all Character Gear to +30
▶ Upgrade all Skills to Lv.10 

 

Clear World Boss: Legend difficulty 

to search the 2nd Potential of Tier-3 or Potential Transcended heroes. 
- The search for 2nd Potential can also proceed by setting your hero as an Ally.
- The 2nd Potential can be Realized for Tier-3 or Potential Transcended heroes.
- The Potential level will be 7 after the 2nd Potential has been realized,
and can be raised to a maximum of 12 as the hero level increases to 80.
* Only Iron Man will be available for 2nd Potential Search, and other heroes will be added in order.

 

 


The Potential level can be increased up to Lv.12, and the character level 
can be increased by +2 each rank to a maximum of Lv.80.
- Life Seed, Essence of Dimension, and Titan Component Pack 
will be consumed when enhancing the Potential Lv. from Potential Lv. 7. 
- The new item “Life Seed” can be acquired from World Boss: Legend.
- After realizing the 2nd Potential, more experience points can be acquired 
when using the same Biometrics with the hero that is being upgraded.
- For some heroes, more experience points can be acquired 
when using specific items instead of the Biometrics of the hero.

 

 


The Character Gear can be enhanced by +1 every two levels from Lv. 72-80 to a maximum of +30.
- Cosmic Cube Fragment, Carbonadium, Soul of the Faltine, and Gold are needed to enhance Character Gear. The new items “Carbonadium and Soul of the Faltine” can each be acquired from World Boss: Legend and Giant Boss Raid: Dormammu.

 

 

The skill level can be enhanced by +1 every two levels from Lv.72-78 to a maximum of +10.
- Life Seed and Gold are needed to enhance a skill.
- The new item “Life Seed” can be acquired from World Boss: Legend.
- The maximum level of Ultimate Skills and Awakened Skills will not be increased.

 

 

Book of the Vishanti, Life Seed, Carbonadium, Soul of the Faltine, and Gold 
are needed to advance a hero that meets all the requirements to Tier-4.
- Tier-4 Advancement materials can be earned from 

Giant Boss Raid: Dormammu and World Boss: Legend.
- The Instinct stats and basic stats of a hero will be increased when a hero is advanced to Tier-4.

 


2. The Striker Skill will be unlocked when a hero is advanced to Tier-4.

 

 

[Striker Skill] 
Equip one owned hero as a Striker. A Tier-4 hero equipped with a Striker can use a Striker Skill.
The skill level will be based on the upgrade level of the equipped hero, and +2 additional levels 
will be applied when the Instinct of the equipped hero matches the Instinct of the Tier-4 hero.

 

 

When the Striker Skill is used, the hero set as a Striker will use a skill 
and an additional buff effect will be applied to the Tier-4 hero.
- The skill button will only be activated when the skill gauge has reached 100%.
The skill gauge will charge as time passes, or when the 1st-5th Active Skills are used.
- The Tier-3 Skill gauge will not be charged when using the Striker Skill, 
and the Striker Skill gauge will not be charged when using the Tier-3 Skill.
- The Striker will have the same stats with the same hero that Agents possess.

 

 

▣ Giant Boss Raid Improvements & New Boss Dormammu Release

 

Show your confidence if you have the abilities to conquer the new Boss: Dormammu!   

 

1. Dormammu will be added as a new Boss.
- The Tier-4 Advancement materials, Soul of the Faltine and Book of the Vishanti, 
can be acquired from Giant Boss Raid: Dormammu.

 

* The type of Book of the Vishanti that can be acquired for each round 
is subject to change as more Tier-4 heroes are added.

 

2. Changes have been made so that Agents can challenge all Giant Boss Raid Bosses 
regardless of the rounds, and the difficulty for each Boss will differ.
1★ = Master Mold
2★ = Galactus
3★ = Dormammu
* A hero that has been used cannot be used in all difficulties 

regardless of the ★ difficulty until the reset.
* The amount of Boost Points required to increase the reward count 

differs based on each ★ difficulty.
Master Mold and Galactus: 35 Points
Dormammu: 40 Points
* The upgrade requirements of the participating heroes and synerge heroes differ based on each 
★ difficulty, and the Synergy Hero for the ★ difficulty will be changed once the level is cleared.
- The upgrade requirements of participating heroes and synerge heroes for each Boss
Master Mold and Galactus: Tier-2, 6★ Advancement & Mastery, Lv. 60
Dormammu: Tier-3 or Potential Transcended, 6★ Advancement & Mastery, Lv. 70
* Agents can enter Giant Boss Raid: Dormammu after the update.
Please refrain from using Potential Transcended & Tier-3 heroes at Giant Boss Raid from
6/1 (Wed) 15:00 - Until the June Update (UTC+0), 6/1 (Wed) 8:00 - Until the June Update (PDT)
for Agents who want to challenge the new Boss right away.
* The preset feature will be shared for all difficulties, 
but only the heroes who meet the requirements for the participating heroes can join the battle.

 

 

3. The number of Agents required to start Giant Boss Raid battles 

has been changed from three to one.
- The difficulty of the Boss increases as more Agents participate, 
but the rewards will be increased as well.
- The stats of the boss and some attack patterns will be changed 
based on the number of Agents who have participated.
* The difficulty and rewards will be set at the start of the battle based on the number of Agents,
and will not be changed even if some Agents leave after the battle has begun.

 

 

[Giant Boss Raid Rewards]

* The daily acquirable count for the new rewards “Soul of the Faltine and 
Book of the Vishanti” and Biometrics: Dormammu will be limited.

 

4. The acquisition location of Card Crafting Cubes has been changed to Dimension Rifts.
- The acquirable amount increases as the difficulty increases.

 

5. The difficulty for Giant Boss Raid: Galactus will be changed.
- The defense and HP have been increased.
- Some patterns have been changed 
and a temporary Invincible effect will be applied when the phase changes.


- The rewards that can be acquired from Galactus have been partially increased.

 

6. The daily acquisition limit of Premium Comic Card Exchange Tokens acquired during
6/1 (Wed) 15:00 - Until the maintenance (UTC+0), 6/1 (Wed) 8:00 - Until the maintenance (PDT)
will not be reset after the maintenance.

 

▣ World Boss: Legend Difficulty Division  

 

The Legend difficulty has been divided based on the strength of
World Boss: Infinity Ultron, Knull, and Mephisto.
Challenge World Bosses that have become even more powerful.

 

1. The difficulty of World Boss: Legend has been divided.
- Legend 1: Knull
- Legend 2: Mephisto
- Legend 3: Infinity Ultron

 

 

2. The rewards for each boss have been improved based on the difficulty division.
- The overall rewards for Mephisto and Infinity Ultron 
has been increased based on the Legend difficulty
- The acquirable amount of Essence of Dimension and Titan Component Pack 
has been increased in all Legend difficulties.
- The Tier-4 Advancement materials, “Life Seed and Carbonadium,”
have been added to the rewards of all Legend difficulties.
* If you need the new materials, please refrain from playing World Boss during 
6/1 (Wed) 15:00 - Until the June Update (UTC+0), 6/1 (Wed) 8:00 - Until the June Update (PDT) 
as Tier-4 materials can be acquired after the update.

 

 

3. The acquisition location of C.T.P. Reforging Core that could be acquired from 
World Boss: Legend difficulty will be changed to Dimension Rifts.
* The C.T.P. Reforging Core rewards that are distributed 
when the S.H.I.E.L.D. Special Support effects are applied will not be changed.
* The acquirable amount increases when Dimension Rift difficulty is higher.

 

4. The Search for 1st Potential has been improved to proceed faster.

 

▣ New Artifacts

 

New Exclusive Passive Skill Artifacts will be added for Iron Man, Ghost Rider (Robbie Reyes), 
Black Widow, Blade, Wasp (Nadia Van Dyne), and Nova (Sam Alexander) after the June Update.

 

* The effects are based on the 6★ Artifact passive skill LV.4 stats.

 

▣ New Future Pass Season & Special Icons

 

A new season of Future Pass will start after the update.
Obtain various rewards along with Special Icons with the Future Pass

 

[Future Pass Rewards]

- Please note that the Future Pass effects will apply upon purchase and cannot be refunded.
- Opened Legendary / Mythic Future Pass will only be applied during the season the Pass was purchased, and the Pass rewards will only be available during the same season. 
Please don’t forget to check the remaining event time!
- The Mythic Pass can only be purchased after purchasing the Legendary Pass.
- Legendary and Mythic Future Pass will not be available for purchase 
when the season is about to end. Please check the sale period in the game.
​

​New Special Icons have been added for our Agents!
Collect two new Icons as Future Pass Rewards and one more from the upcoming Events!


[June Update New Special Icon]

          


▣ One New Uniform Collection

 

Check out the new Uniforms from the June Update!
Complete the collection by achieving the specified conditions and earn a reward

 

 

▣ Other Improvements and Changes

 

1. Improvements have been made so that the acquisition location of Power Saving Mode themes 

will be shown regardless of the acquisition status.

 

2. The minimum MARVEL Future Fight OS support specifications has been changed.
Before: AOS 4.4 / IOS 11
After: AOS 5.1 / IOS 12
 
3. Improvements have been made so that Agents can move to the Inventory 
when tapping the “Go to” button of challenges related to ISO-8, Custom Gear, and Enchanted Uru.
 
4. The type “Magic” has been added to Mordo <Marvel Studios’ Doctor Strange> 
and Mordo <Marvel Studios’ Doctor Strange 2>.
 
5. The role of supporter has been added to Wong 

as a Recommended Position in the Marvel Universe.
 
6. The name of the following item has been changed.
Before: Potential Realization Ticket / Superior Potential Realization Ticket
After: 1st Potential Realization Ticket / Superior 1st Potential Realization Ticket
- The function of the item is the same as before, 
and the item cannot be used for 2nd Potential Realization.

 

7. Arabic will no longer be supported.

 

8. The AR feature for Alliance Tournament and Alliance Conquest will no longer be supported.
 

▣ Game Error Fixes
 

1. The issue of the Crystals stored in the Inbox being received first when acquiring 
Crystal products instantly from the purchase pop-up screen has been fixed.
 
2. The issue of an error pop-up showing up when repeatedly touching the 
Matchmaking button quickly in the Multiverse Invasion tutorial process has been fixed.
 
3. The issue of the stat of the “increases all buffs” effect of Ancient One <Unleashed Mystic> 
being displayed wrongly in certain cases has been fixed.
 
4. The issue of the Invisibility effect not being applied as intended when equipping 

Ancient One <Marvel Studios’ Doctor Strange> and <Unleashed Mystic> has been fixed.
 
5. The intermittent issue of not being able to attack Green Goblin in Story Stage 7-1 has been fixed.
 
6. The issue of some information not being renewed 
when changing the defense deck after being chosen as the Master of Shadowland has been fixed.
 
7. The issue of the UI icon at the top of the hero HP bar 
not being displayed correctly in certain circumstances has been fixed.
 
8. The issue of the ISO-8 settings of the opponent 
not being applied correctly in Timeline Battle has been fixed.

 

We will return with various content improvements, so please stay tuned.

 

Thank you.
